header: The "Change password" window of a signed-in person. It opens from the account menu in the top bar, and by itself after sign-in when the password has run out (180 days): then it cannot be closed, only filled in or left by signing out, and it says in words that the password has expired and for how many days a new one is valid. I make it ask the server first (may this person change it here; has it run out; is a one-time code needed), then it takes the current password and the new one twice. Important: none of the three password boxes accepts copy, cut, paste or drop, because a password is typed, twice, by the person. The rules, the last-5 check and the one-time code belong to the server (src/app/api/account/password/route.ts, src/lib/security/changePassword.ts); the window only shows what the server answers. Nothing typed here is stored in the browser.
